items.title: Anime Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Your favorite series are animes and you now want to live in a free world as an anime character? You're lucky, in our pack, there are 10 different skins and you can choose anyone.

+ 10 different skins
+ Teen look
+ Modern style
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Trendy Style 2021
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
These skins are very trendy! Find the next modern and stylish look in this pack of skins! Unleash your true personality with these trendy outfits and live the life of your dreams!

Also perfect for PvP and PvE!

+ 25 Trendy Style 2021 Skins

items.title: Baking Buddies
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
It's getting heated in the kitchen, time to throw on your chef's hat! From donuts to cookies, dress up with this pack to be prepared for the mayhem in the kitchen. When the flour flies and the sweet treats bake, you'll be perfectly ready for it all! 

- 8 Baker Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Farm Friends
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Ever wanted to escape to the countryside and live off the land? Well, you'll need to accessorize first, and what better way to do it than with these fantastic Farm Friends skins! The simple life is just a few clicks away.

- 8 Farm Fresh Skins!
- by Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Vampire Nobles
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Become a member of high society in a world of darkness. Waltz with monarchs to elegant, classical music, and dine on the finest delicacies. Sink your teeth into this fabulous skin pack to taste that flavorful, dreamlike fantasy!

- 8 Fashionable Vampire Skins!
- Perfect for roleplaying!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Demons vs Angels
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Unleash your inner immortal! Will you choose the side of serenity and order or the side of chaos and fire? With ten unique skins to pick from, the question remains: will you be a darling deity or a devious demon?

- 5 Demon Skins!
- 5 Angel Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Animal Hats
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
It's time to renew your style with fun animal hats. Enjoy this winter with your friends showing off your new and beautiful outfit on your adventures.

- There are 10 skins with different hats.

By KubocStudios.

items.title: Overpowered Weapons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Craft the most powerful weapons in Minecraft! There are exploding throwing stars, TNT swords, lightning axes, and more! Every weapon has unique special abilities that allow the beholder to be more powerful than ever!

- Overpowered weapons
- Special abilities
- Training arena
- 6 Skins
- Play in Japanese

items.title: Gamer Mobs HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
These mobs have given up their usual day jobs and have started gaming! Dress up as your favorite hostile mob with sleek neon gamer fashion. Featuring gaming headsets and cool pixel art designs.

+ 11 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Diamond Skyblock

Diamonds make everything better, including skyblock! Begin your skyblock journey with a loot chest filled with OP diamond tools!

items.creator: Hourglass Studios

Be a cartoon with your favorite mobs in the game! These cartoony vibes are sure to bring your survival experiences to a whole new level. Pick from the enderman, warden, axolotl, and many more cool skins! Even become the ender dragon skin!

-15 cartoon mob skins! 
-Caves and cliffs mobs added!
-By: Hourglass Studios
